privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
privacy.intro: RDV connects car owners with garages in Luxembourg for booking and paying for automotive services online. This page explains what data we collect, why, and the rights you have over it.
privacy.accountDataBody: your name, email address, and role (client, garage, mechanic). Passwords are handled entirely by our authentication provider and are never stored in our own database.
privacy.vehicleDataBody: make, model, and year for vehicles you save to your account, used to speed up booking.
privacy.bookingDataBody: the garage, service, date, time, and status of each appointment, plus any messages you exchange with a garage about a booking.
privacy.paymentDataBody: payments are processed entirely by Stripe. We never see or store your card details; we retain the resulting invoice and transaction records (amount, date, commission) required to run the marketplace and meet legal obligations.
privacy.garageBusinessDataBody: for garage accounts: business name, address, VAT number, business registration number, and verification documents (business registration, insurance, certifications) uploaded for review.
privacy.locationDataBody: garage addresses and coordinates, used to show garages on a map and let clients search nearby.
privacy.deviceDataBody: if you enable push notifications, a device token used to deliver them.
privacy.whoWeShareBody: We use a small number of processors to run the platform, each only receiving what they need to do their job: Stripe (payments and payouts), Google Maps (garage location display), Firebase Cloud Messaging (push notifications), Resend (transactional email), and Supabase (database, authentication, and file storage hosting). We do not sell personal data to anyone.
privacy.howLongBody1: Invoices and payment records are retained as required by applicable Luxembourg commercial and tax law (commonly up to 10 years), even after an account is closed, since we cannot selectively erase legally-required financial records. Other personal data — your profile, vehicles, messages, and device tokens — is kept only while your account is active.
privacy.howLongBody2: If a garage account is closed, its verification documents are deleted; the garage's past appointments, invoices, and reviews remain, since those records also belong in part to the clients who used that garage.
privacy.yourRightsBodyPrefix: You can access and update most of your own data directly in the app. You can request deletion of your account at any time from
privacy.yourRightsBodySuffix: , which schedules your profile to be anonymized after a grace period during which you can cancel the request — financial records tied to your account are retained as described above and are not affected. You also have the right to object to or restrict certain processing, to receive a copy of your data, and to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority (in Luxembourg, the CNPD).
privacy.bookingTermsBody: Booking a service is a request sent to the garage; the garage confirms availability before your appointment is finalized. Payment is collected at the time of booking. Cancellation and refund terms are set by the individual garage and shown on their profile; contact the garage directly, or your platform administrator if a dispute can't be resolved directly.
